# Name: # Two-slot OTA layout for a 4 MB flash. There is deliberately no `factory`
# partition: both apps live in ota_0/ota_1 and the bootloader picks which to run
# from the `otadata` partition (esp_ota / ota_data_initial.bin point at ota_0 on
# first flash). ESP-IDF places the freshly built app in ota_0 at 0x20000 and the
# OTA image is downloaded into the other slot at runtime.
#   otadata  0xf000  (8K — holds the two-slot boot selection)
#   ota_1    0x1d0000 (1700K) — OTA download target; ends at 0x380000
# Note: if you increase the bootloader size
# overlaps (the partition table must fit in 0x8000-0x9000).
